question:
Do mutations causing low HDL-C promote increased
               carotid intima-media thickness?
text:
Although observational data support an inverse relationship
           between high-density lipoprotein (HDL (high-density lipoprotein))
           cholesterol and coronary heart disease (CHD (coronary heart
           disease)), genetic HDL (high-density lipoprotein) deficiency
           states often do not correlate with premature CHD (coronary
           heart disease).
answer:
Mutations causing low HDL-C levels do not appear to be
             consistently associated with subclinical atherosclerosis...
